title: Order-Issue Credit in Cartwise Grocery Orders Photo-Review Claims
content:
# Order-issue credit in Cartwise Grocery Orders photo-review claims

**Order-issue credit** — a fixed credit on a photo-review claim, set by the item refunds already standing on the Cartwise Grocery Orders order.

**Rule.** When the order carries an item refund for a missing, damaged, wrong-item or quality issue and a price-protection refund, the credit is 1.50; when it carries such an issue refund and no price-protection refund, the credit is 0.75; otherwise there is none. The credit is added to the photo-review claim amount after the claim figure is rounded to the cent.

An issue refund is an item refund entry whose reason is missing, damaged, wrong item or quality. A price-protection refund is an item refund entry whose reason is substitution price protection. Both are read across the whole order, not only the claimed line.

## Truth table

| Issue refund standing on the order | Price-protection refund standing | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.50 |
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| No | Yes | None |
| No | No | None |

## Hypothetical orders

- A missing refund on one line and a price-protection refund on another line of the same order: 1.50.
- A quality refund only: 0.75.
- A price-protection refund and a weight-overage refund, with no missing, damaged, wrong-item or quality refund: none.
